schema_status: Exact old record schema and list-based JSON structure preserved

weighting_design.route_weight_method: Equal-weight baseline: 1/20 = 0.05 per directional route. Replace with verified traffic-based weights later if a validated source is adopted.

improvement_notes: Raw fare schema was not expanded; compatibility with the old structure was prioritised.
Weights are separated from raw observations so methodology can change without regenerating fare data.
Synthetic anomalies remain unlabelled to allow the ETL outlier detector to perform the detection.
